predecessors.name: Mecklenburg
predecessors.text: Mecklenburg-Schwerin, a state of the Holy Roman Empire since the partition of 1701, with Wismar and the southern strip

successors.name: Weimar Republic
successors.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free State of Mecklenburg-Schwerin)

rulers.name: Frederick Francis I
rulers.title: Duke to 1815, Grand Duke from 14 June 1815

ledger.x: 1806: the map begins with Mecklenburg-Schwerin as the Holy Roman Empire ends.
1808: the occupation ends with the accession to the Confederation of the Rhine on 22 March 1808.
1815: the duchy becomes a grand duchy.
14 November 1918: the grand duke renounces the throne.

wars.name: War of the Fourth Coalition
wars.outcome: The duchy was overrun by France in 1806 and joined the Confederation of the Rhine in 1808 (Confederation page: 22 March 1808); no land changed hands.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: Frederick Francis I became 'the first member of the confederation to abandon Napoleon' and 'in 1813-1814 he fought against France'; no border moved (the Confederation was dissolved by the allies on 4 November 1813).

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The duke backed Prussia (Grand Duchy page); Mecklenburg-Schwerin joined the North German Confederation in 1867.

certainty.note: Cliopatria's outline of the duchy from administrative maps; none of the pages gives a boundary.
Borders of a member state of the German Confederation after the Congress of Vienna; the pages record no change of border, and the outline is the same to within 1 percent of area throughout.
